metadata.title: Customer Ticketing System
metadata.description: Submit and track support requests, in English or Arabic.

landing.title: Support that keeps you informed
landing.subtitle: Raise a request, follow its progress and talk to the team handling it — in English or Arabic, from any device.

features.trackBody: A reference number, a status and a full history for every ticket you raise.
features.respondBody: Conversations, attachments and updates stay attached to the request.
features.slaBody: Each priority has a published first-response and resolution target.

landing.staffNote: Support staff sign in here too — the console opens automatically for internal accounts.

auth.signInSubtitle: Enter the email address and password for your account.
auth.signUpSubtitle: You will receive an email to confirm your address before you can raise a request.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email address and we will send you a reset link if an account exists.
auth.resetSubtitle: Enter a new password for your account.
auth.verifySubtitle: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.

portal.title: Your account
portal.phaseNote: Ticket submission and tracking arrive in the next phase. This account is ready and your profile is stored.
portal.profileSubtitle: These details are used on your requests and notifications.

console.title: Support console
console.noTeams: Not yet a member of a team
console.phaseNote: Ticket queues, assignment and SLA tooling arrive in the next phases. Access control for this console is already enforced.
console.manageUsersBody: Invite staff, grant roles, and suspend or reactivate accounts.
console.manageTeamsBody: See the teams tickets are routed to and how many staff each holds.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Staff accounts, roles and access. Customers register themselves.
users.viewerNoAccess: Your account has read-only access and cannot manage users.
users.noAccess: Managing users requires the administrator role.
users.emptyHint: Adjust the search or filters, or invite a staff member above.
users.loadError: The user directory could not be loaded.
users.permissionCount: {count} permission codes are defined for the five roles.

invite.title: Invite a staff member
invite.subtitle: They receive an email to set a password. Staff accounts cannot create tickets.
invite.roleHint: A team leader can manage their own team but cannot appoint other leaders.
invite.sent: Invitation sent. The account is active once they set a password.

teams.title: Teams
teams.subtitle: Departments and support teams that tickets are routed to.
teams.emptyHint: Teams are created by an administrator.
teams.phaseNote: Creating teams, editing membership and workload views arrive with the ticket queue in the next phase.

validation.passwordShort: Password must be at least 10 characters.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email address before signing in.
errors.accountSuspended: This account is suspended. Contact support.
errors.emailInUse: An account with this email address already exists.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.notConfigured: The application is not connected to a database yet.
errors.unauthorized: You do not have access to this page.
errors.lastAdmin: This is the last active administrator, so this change is not allowed.
errors.roleConflict: Staff and customer roles cannot be combined. Remove the other role first.
errors.statusTransition: That account status change is not allowed.
errors.staffOnlyTeams: Only staff accounts can belong to a support team.
errors.leaderAdminOnly: Only an administrator can appoint a team leader.
errors.selfStatus: You cannot suspend or deactivate your own account.
errors.inviteNotConfigured: Staff invitations need the server key. Ask an administrator to configure it.
